name: scroll-to-panel-transform
intent: A round scroll token morphs via scale/clip into a rectangular panel — one continuous container, not a content crossfade.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Panel appears fully expanded with content visible; no morph

acceptance: Token morphs width/height/radius in morphMs 480 from 64px circle to full-width × panelHPx 176 panel
Panel copy reveals via clip-path inset expand — no opacity crossfade of glyph↔copy
Token exits via scale + clip inset collapse (not a fade-only swap)
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows OPENED panel immediately with transitions disabled
